rows.jyutping: baat3 sap6 gei2 seoi3 ge3 jan4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to refer to a person aged 80 to 89.

example.english: That octogenarian goes to the park for morning exercise every day.
example.traditional: 嗰位八十幾歲嘅人日日都去公園晨運。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 baat3 sap6 gei2 seoi3 ge3 jan4 jat6 jat6 dou1 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 san4 wan6
